values.note: $30 per site, the same in recreation.gov's 2026, 2027 and 2028 tables; includes two vehicles or one RV, and a third vehicle is $11 a night. Firewood $10 a bundle from the host.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/silver-dollar-campground ('$30 fee per site for overnight camping, which includes two vehicles or one RV. $11 fee for a third vehicle.'; last updated July 31, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232294/rates (2026, 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30) + recreation.gov notice ('Firewood is available for sale at host site for $10.00/bundle'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232294 (notice 'No hookups available') + campsite catalog for 232294 (all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 38 reservable family sites, all back-in, nearly all rated for 30 ft; gravel or dirt spurs. One RV and two tents, or three tents, per site.

sites.source: campsite catalog for 232294 (38 STANDARD NONELECTRIC reservable + 8 MANAGEMENT not; Max Vehicle Length 30 on 39 sites, 20 on one; Driveway Entry Back-In on all) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232294 ('Parking spurs are gravel or dirt', '3 tent maximum per site, or 1 RV and 2 tents'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: No drinking water in 2025 or 2026 (bring your own); the RV dump stations at nearby Printer Boy and White Star campgrounds were also closed in 2026. Firewood sold by the host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/silver-dollar-campground ('Vault toilets are located throughout the campground', 'Potable water is not available at this site. Water will not be available in this campground in 2025.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232294 ('Water will NOT be available in this campground in 2026 ... the RV Dump Stations at both Printer Boy & White Star Campgrounds will remain closed this season'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'May to September', weather dependent; water, trash or a host may be missing early and late. Dates are recreation.gov's 2027 fee seasons (reservable May 21 - Sept 5, first-come Sept 6-18); 2026 ran May 22 - Sept 19.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/silver-dollar-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September', 'Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232294/rates (2026 Peak 05-22 to 09-07 and 09-08 to 09-19; 2027 Peak 05-21 to 09-05, First-come, First-served Season 09-06 to 09-18), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 at least four days ahead; 2027 bookings run May 21 - Sept 5, and Sept 6-18 is first-come (2026 was reservable to Sept 19). The Forest Service requires Friday and Saturday together on weekends and three nights on holiday weekends, but walk-ups are exempt; recreation.gov's own rules list no minimum. 14 consecutive nights at most.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/silver-dollar-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232294 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4) + /rates (2027 seasons) + availability (May and Jun 2027 'NYR' from 05-21), read 2026-10-26

note: Lodgepole and subalpine-fir forest at about 9,900 ft near the east shore of Turquoise Lake, west of Leadville (Leadville RD, Pike-San Isabel NF); the 1.2-mile Turquoise Lake Nature Trail runs to the shoreline and Molly Brown campground, and Matchless Boat Ramp is nearby. Reached via County Road 9C. --Claude
summary: FS page (July 2026), rec.gov facility, rates, catalog: confirmed $30 (2026-2028), no hookups, 38 sites, 30-ft max. flags: Entry phone is empty. Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749 (FS page; recreation.gov lists it 'for information only, no reservations'); recreation.gov gives (661) 702-1420 for facility-specific information (concessionaire).

No drinking water: the FS page says none in 2025 and recreation.gov says none in 2026 (potable_water written false); the nearby Printer Boy and White Star dump stations were closed in 2026. Recheck before the 2027 season.
